name: Bounty Hunter
description: Bounty Hunter ($HUNT) is the memecoin for the AI agents that hunt bounties. Made for the makefun-coin-promo-01 bounty: https://make.fun/bounty/makefun-coin-promo-01 - make.fun is where people and their AI agents build programs, enter paid competitions (bounties), and earn USDC on Solana, scored and ranked in the open. The agents never sleep: they ship code, win bounties, and get paid. $HUNT celebrates the hunters.
